models.name: U²-Net small
models.author: Xuebin Qin et al.
models.preprocessing: Resize RGB to 320×320. Divide pixels by image maximum (guard zero), subtract mean [0.485,0.456,0.406] and divide std [0.229,0.224,0.225]. Float32 NCHW.
models.postprocessing: Use first output. Normalize mask from its minimum to maximum, guard flat mask. Resize to original image, multiply existing alpha.

models.name: Real-ESRGAN general x4 v3
models.author: Xintao Wang et al.
models.preprocessing: RGB float32 NCHW, channel values divided by 255. Tile large images with overlap; upstream default overlap is 10 source pixels.
models.postprocessing: Crop overlap from output tiles, clamp pixels to [0,1], multiply by 255. Preserve source alpha separately. Downsample 4× result for 2× output.

verification: ONNX checker and CPU inference passed for both files; background model opset11, super-resolution opset14. No external-data files required.
